---
title: "Irish Kidney Disease Data System (IKDDS)"
---

The **IKDDS** is the national data system for End-Stage Kidney Disease (ESKD) and
haemodialysis audit in Ireland. It extracts patient data from hospital **eMed**
systems, standardises it to the **UKRR Dataset v5.1**, stores it in **REDCap**, and
reports it through an interactive audit dashboard.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[eMed<br/>SQL Server] -->|ETL| B[(REDCap<br/>registry)]
  B --> C[Dashboard<br/>national HD audit]
  A -.notes.-> N[ikdds-nlp] -.coded fields.-> A
  B --> D[ikdds-data-management<br/>QC & reconciliation]
```

## Repositories

| Repo | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [ikdds-etl](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-etl) | eMed → UKRR v5.1 → REDCap ETL pipeline. **Canonical data dictionary.** |
| [ikdds-dashboard](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-dashboard) | Shiny audit dashboard (23 metrics, 14 pages). |
| [ikdds-data-management-documentation](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-data-management-documentation) | Governance docs as Markdown (private). |
| [ikdds-nlp](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-nlp) | NLP over eMed clinical notes (scaffold). |
| [ikdds-data-management](https://github.com/ikddsystem/ikdds-data-management) | Data-manager QC toolkit (scaffold). |

## Documentation principle

Wherever possible, documentation is **auto-generated from code**. The ETL package's
data dictionary is the single source of truth for field definitions; the DRS, CRF, DMP,
and the dashboard's field mappings derive from it. See [Architecture](architecture.qmd).
